counterfactual_missing_items: spindle-cell or stromal histology on biopsy
decisive_items: a 6 cm mass arising from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum
biopsy results were consistent with adipose tissue
response.rationale: C1 is the most complete: it preserves the gastric lipoma diagnosis and adds the raw-supported antral location. Fat attenuation and adipose-tissue biopsy are decisive for lipoma and exclude GIST. R1 is the same core diagnosis but lacks the antral modifier; R2 relies only on a shared nonspecific muscularis propria mass and is contradicted by the fat/adipose findings.

rejected.why: Only shared mass/muscularis propria spans; fat attenuation and adipose-tissue biopsy are incompatible with GIST and no GIST-specific raw evidence is present.
